mapper.select: SELECT f.* FROM `t_archive_file` f WHERE f.`del_flag` = 0 AND f.`archive_id` = #{archiveId} ORDER BY f.`sort_no`, f.`seq_no`, f.`create_time`
SELECT f.* FROM `t_archive_file` f WHERE f.`del_flag` = 0 AND f.`id` = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `t_archive_file` f WHERE f.`del_flag` = 0 AND (f.`category_path` = #{categoryPath} OR f.`category_path` LIKE CONCAT(#{categoryPath}, '/%'))
